GOAL: Establish the design direction for ideation_5 before proposing.
READ: Searched the tool catalog and confirmed the only write is append_progress; reviewed the three prior rounds' selected ideas (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID feedback-curvature, BRad-RQ radial behaviour-ranked assignment) and their rejected probes (MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID).
OBSERVED: Prior rounds all attacked (a) codebook/Frechet updates, (b) per-level curvature control, (c) radial assignment ranking. None used behaviour-directed geodesic transport of the encoder output, none used a Lorentz/Poincare mid-training re-anchoring of the whole prefix tree, none used transition-operator spectral structure as a curvature field.
EVIDENCE: The round history in the prompt; earlier rounds report math=NOT_RUN and no recall metric, so nothing is confirmed working.
REASONING: To be distinct I will occupy the 'behaviour-directed curved residual transport / prefix re-anchoring' part of the space rather than assignment weighting or per-level curvature.
OPEN: Write the single in-scope proposal with full equations, switches, cost and leakage boundary.

GOAL: Deliver the final single in-scope proposal for ideation_5, distinct from the four blind siblings and from the three earlier rounds.
READ: The round history in the prompt. Earlier selected ideas: poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (successor-weighted Frechet codebook update), CURVCTRL-SID (per-level curvature from a prefix transition score), BRad-RQ (behaviour-ranked radial assignment); the rejected probes cover Lorentz successor profiles, behaviour cones, mixed-curvature MoE RQ, successor-boosted geometric shift, TSG-SID. All probes report math=NOT_RUN.
OBSERVED: Every earlier mechanism acts on the codebook, on a per-level curvature schedule, or on the radial ranking of the assignment. None transforms the latent that is presented to the quantizer, and none uses successor branching concentration as a displacement magnitude.
EVIDENCE: The prompt's round history; no recall number was ever produced, so no prior mechanism is empirically supported.
REASONING: Chosen position is 'behaviour-directed geodesic transport between encoder and quantizer'. Training-only directed transitions give a top-20 popularity-adjusted successor distribution per item; its normalised entropy gives branching concentration conc_j; m_j/(m_j+m_med) is a measured support shrinkage. Successor consensus s_j is the 3-step hyperbolic Frechet mean of the successors' current full-prefix code embeddings (detached, per-epoch). Both meet in one expression: v'_j = R log_0(exp_{x_j}(w_j log_{x_j}(s_j))), w_j = conc_j m_j/(m_j+m_med). Behaviour-off sets w=0 and is bit-exact baseline; geometry-off replaces the geodesic by a tangent-space chord; both-on is the trained arm. c=1 fixed, R = median batch ||z|| measured at epoch 0, so no constant is tuned. Cost: 4 elementwise maps per item plus 94M MACs per epoch refresh, about 3.9M MACs per step at 24 steps/epoch, under 1 percent wall clock at 24556 items, K=20, d=64, 3000 epochs.
OPEN: None. The full answer block was printed in the response as required (BRANCHFLOW-PB-TRANSPORT); it is final.
